assertions.assertion: The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
mobile cardiac telemetry is medically ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms
establishing the medical necessity for CPT 93229 as documented in the clinical indication
